test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: There are 21 persons and there are three languages - French German and Japanese. 10 persons speak German, 12 persons speak Japanese, and 10 persons speak French. 4 can speak only French and 5 can speak only Japanese. 4 can speak French as well as German. 3 persons can speak all languages. How many persons speak Japanese and German?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3594344f2a9eec51ff7192d23744757d97388fe70307f3c763ca7e9f9b5de302.png] 

**Given**

Number of person = 21

Number of persons speak German = 10

Number of persons speak Japanese = 12

Number of persons speak French = 10

**Calculation**

Let number of person speak French, German and Japanese represents by F, G and J.

French persons = a + b + c + g = 10

Japanese persons = b + d + g + e = 12

German = c + g + e + f = 10

Persons speak all languages, g = 3
